pr.body:
Closes #37428

<!---

pr.title: Add a HTML sanitizer for translated message resources

raw_findings.body: Instead of emitting an 'Illegal HTML' validation message, the verifier crashes with an unhandled StringIndexOutOfBoundsException, aborting the Maven build with a confusing stack trace and hiding the actual translation problem.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Runtime exception in the mojo replaces a diagnostic message and fails the build ungracefully.
raw_findings.impact: Instead of emitting an 'Illegal HTML' validation message, the verifier crashes with an unhandled StringIndexOutOfBoundsException, aborting the Maven build with a confusing stack trace and hiding the actual translation problem.
raw_findings.root_cause: The prefix and suffix trimming loops are computed independently without guarding against their overlap, so the substring bounds can invert.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Clamp the suffix scan so start + end never exceeds min(value.length(), sanitized.length()), e.g. add 'start + end < value.length() && start + end < sanitized.length()' to the second while condition.
raw_findings.title: Diff-trimming logic can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when prefix and suffix overlap
raw_findings.trigger: A message value that ends with an unclosed tag, e.g. 'text': the sanitizer balances it to 'text', so the common-prefix scan consumes the whole value (start=7) while the common-suffix scan independently matches '>' and 'b' (end=2), making start > value.length()-end and value.substring(7, 5) throws.

raw_findings.body: i18next does not understand Java MessageFormat single-brace placeholders or the '{2,choice,...}' construct, so the error message can render with literal '{0}', '{1}' and the raw choice expression instead of the attribute name and counts.
raw_findings.evidence: error-invalid-multivalued-size=Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.
raw_findings.failure_mode: User-facing validation error displays unreplaced placeholders/raw choice syntax.
raw_findings.impact: i18next does not understand Java MessageFormat single-brace placeholders or the '{2,choice,...}' construct, so the error message can render with literal '{0}', '{1}' and the raw choice expression instead of the attribute name and counts.
raw_findings.root_cause: The server-theme MessageFormat string was copied verbatim into a JS-app bundle whose established placeholder convention is i18next '{{n}}' interpolation.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Keep the account-ui English value in i18next syntax (e.g. 'Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).') or verify/convert the choice construct through the pipeline that actually formats these messages before merging.
raw_findings.title: MessageFormat choice syntax placed in i18next account-ui English bundle
raw_findings.trigger: A user-profile multivalue size validation error is rendered in the account console (keycloak.v3), whose messages are consumed by i18next with '{{n}}' interpolation as used by every neighboring key in this file (e.g. "'{{0}}' contains invalid character.").

raw_findings.root_cause: Server-theme MessageFormat string copied into a JS-app i18next bundle, diverging from the file's placeholder convention and from the '{{0}}' style still used by this key's community translations.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Keep this admin-ui English value in i18next '{{n}}' syntax, or confirm and document the conversion layer that transforms MessageFormat syntax before it reaches i18next.

raw_findings.impact: The mojo aborts with an unhandled RuntimeException and stack trace instead of the MojoExecutionException/validation-message contract used by the rest of verify(), producing an unhelpful build failure.
raw_findings.root_cause: verifySafeHtml converts IOException into RuntimeException rather than using the declared MojoExecutionException/messages reporting path.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Throw MojoExecutionException (propagated through verify()) or append a descriptive entry to 'messages' when the English counterpart cannot be read, consistent with verifyNoDuplicateKeys error handling.
raw_findings.title: Missing English counterpart file crashes verifier with raw RuntimeException
raw_findings.trigger: verify() runs on a community message bundle whose derived English path (after 'resources-community'->'resources' and locale-suffix substitution) does not exist, e.g. a community-only theme directory or a bundle whose filename does not match the substitution assumptions.

raw_findings.body: Fields named in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constant convention are actually non-static, non-final, package-visible instance state, misleading readers and needlessly recompiling immutable policies/patterns for each of the hundreds of message files in the build.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Misleading naming plus repeated construction of immutable objects per verified file.
raw_findings.impact: Fields named in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constant convention are actually non-static, non-final, package-visible instance state, misleading readers and needlessly recompiling immutable policies/patterns for each of the hundreds of message files in the build.
raw_findings.root_cause: New fields follow constant naming without constant declaration modifiers, inconsistent with ANCHOR_PATTERN in the same class.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Declare POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML and HTML_TAGS as 'private static final', matching the adjacent ANCHOR_PATTERN declaration.
raw_findings.title: Constant-named policy/pattern fields declared as mutable package-private instance fields
raw_findings.trigger: ThemeVerifierMojo creates a new VerifyMessageProperties instance per message file, rebuilding both PolicyFactory objects (and the HTML_TAGS Pattern at R139) for every file scanned.

raw_findings.body:
A regression that makes verifySafeHtml over-report (e.g. flagging identical anchors or allowed /

tags in every locale, which would fail the whole Keycloak build) would not be caught by the test suite.
raw_findings.failure_mode: False-positive regressions in the verifier would silently pass CI for the plugin while breaking the main build.
raw_findings.impact:
A regression that makes verifySafeHtml over-report (e.g. flagging identical anchors or allowed /

tags in every locale, which would fail the whole Keycloak build) would not be caught by the test suite.
raw_findings.root_cause: New verifySafeHtml behavior is only covered by negative-path tests.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add a fixture pair where the translation reuses the exact anchor/allowed tags from the English file and assert verify() returns an empty list (no 'Illegal HTML' or 'Didn't find anchor tag' entries).
raw_findings.title: No positive test asserting valid HTML/anchors pass the new sanitizer checks
raw_findings.trigger: All three new tests only assert that a violation message is produced; none verifies that a legitimate translation (allowed tags matching the English source, or anchors identical to the English anchor) yields an empty result list.

raw_findings.body: Lithuanian users see the first TOTP setup instruction in Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:") while every other message on the page is Lithuanian, replacing the previous Lithuanian text and degrading localization correctness.
raw_findings.evidence: loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:
raw_findings.failure_mode: Wrong-language string is served for the lt locale at runtime; no build or verifier failure occurs because the value is valid, so the regression ships silently.
raw_findings.impact: Lithuanian users see the first TOTP setup instruction in Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:") while every other message on the page is Lithuanian, replacing the previous Lithuanian text and degrading localization correctness.
raw_findings.root_cause: While removing the HTML anchor tags from loginTotpStep1, the replacement text was copied from the Italian bundle (identical to messages_it.properties) rather than translated into Lithuanian.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Replace the value with a Lithuanian translation of the new English source string (e.g. "Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame įrenginyje:") instead of the Italian text copied from messages_it.properties.
raw_findings.title: Italian translation inserted into Lithuanian message bundle for loginTotpStep1
raw_findings.trigger: A user with the Lithuanian (lt) locale opens the OTP/TOTP setup page during login (e.g. the CONFIGURE_TOTP required action), which renders the loginTotpStep1 message.

finding.body: Lithuanian users see the first TOTP setup instruction in Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:") while every other message on the page is Lithuanian, replacing the previous Lithuanian text and degrading localization correctness.
finding.evidence: loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:
finding.failure_mode: Wrong-language string is served for the lt locale at runtime; no build or verifier failure occurs because the value is valid, so the regression ships silently.
finding.impact: Lithuanian users see the first TOTP setup instruction in Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:") while every other message on the page is Lithuanian, replacing the previous Lithuanian text and degrading localization correctness.
finding.root_cause: While removing the HTML anchor tags from loginTotpStep1, the replacement text was copied from the Italian bundle (identical to messages_it.properties) rather than translated into Lithuanian.
finding.suggested_fix: Replace the value with a Lithuanian translation of the new English source string (e.g. "Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame įrenginyje:") instead of the Italian text copied from messages_it.properties.
finding.title: Italian translation inserted into Lithuanian message bundle for loginTotpStep1
finding.trigger: A user with the Lithuanian (lt) locale opens the OTP/TOTP setup page during login (e.g. the CONFIGURE_TOTP required action), which renders the loginTotpStep1 message.
finding.verifier_reason: This describes the same Italian-in-Lithuanian translation error as candidate 1, but for loginTotpStep1 in login/messages_lt.properties (line R71) vs totpStep1 in account/messages_lt.properties (line R101). Both are the same causal defect (copy-paste from Italian bundle) at different independently fixable sites.

validated_findings.body: Instead of emitting an 'Illegal HTML' validation message, the verifier crashes with an unhandled StringIndexOutOfBoundsException, aborting the Maven build with a confusing stack trace and hiding the actual translation problem.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Runtime exception in the mojo replaces a diagnostic message and fails the build ungracefully.
validated_findings.impact: Instead of emitting an 'Illegal HTML' validation message, the verifier crashes with an unhandled StringIndexOutOfBoundsException, aborting the Maven build with a confusing stack trace and hiding the actual translation problem.
validated_findings.root_cause: The prefix and suffix trimming loops are computed independently without guarding against their overlap, so the substring bounds can invert.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Clamp the suffix scan so start + end never exceeds min(value.length(), sanitized.length()), e.g. add 'start + end < value.length() && start + end < sanitized.length()' to the second while condition.
validated_findings.title: Diff-trimming logic can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when prefix and suffix overlap
validated_findings.trigger: A message value that ends with an unclosed tag, e.g. 'text': the sanitizer balances it to 'text', so the common-prefix scan consumes the whole value (start=7) while the common-suffix scan independently matches '>' and 'b' (end=2), making start > value.length()-end and value.substring(7, 5) throws.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch adds lines R102-R111 with independent prefix/suffix loops. When sanitized equals value except for a small middle portion, start can exceed value.length()-end, causing StringIndexOutOfBoundsException on line R111. The trigger scenario (e.g., 'text' sanitized to 'text') is realistic.

validated_findings.failure_mode: Locale-inconsistent text shipped in the zh_CN resource bundle.
validated_findings.impact: The instruction uses Traditional Chinese characters and vocabulary (手機, 應用程式) that belong to zh_TW, which is inconsistent with the Simplified Chinese used by every surrounding key (e.g. '手机', '应用') and reads as the wrong locale to zh_CN users.
validated_findings.root_cause: The replacement string was copied from a Traditional Chinese (zh_TW-style) translation into the zh_CN bundle.

validated_findings.title: Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) totpStep1 written in Traditional Chinese
validated_findings.trigger: A user views the OTP setup page of the account console with the zh_CN (Simplified Chinese) locale.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch line R112 in messages_zh_CN.properties shows '在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：' using Traditional Chinese characters (手機, 應用程式) while surrounding keys use Simplified Chinese (手机, 应用). This is locale-inconsistent text introduced by the patch.

validated_findings.body: i18next does not understand Java MessageFormat single-brace placeholders or the '{2,choice,...}' construct, so the error message can render with literal '{0}', '{1}' and the raw choice expression instead of the attribute name and counts.
validated_findings.evidence: error-invalid-multivalued-size=Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.
validated_findings.failure_mode: User-facing validation error displays unreplaced placeholders/raw choice syntax.
validated_findings.impact: i18next does not understand Java MessageFormat single-brace placeholders or the '{2,choice,...}' construct, so the error message can render with literal '{0}', '{1}' and the raw choice expression instead of the attribute name and counts.
validated_findings.root_cause: The server-theme MessageFormat string was copied verbatim into a JS-app bundle whose established placeholder convention is i18next '{{n}}' interpolation.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Keep the account-ui English value in i18next syntax (e.g. 'Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).') or verify/convert the choice construct through the pipeline that actually formats these messages before merging.
validated_findings.title: MessageFormat choice syntax placed in i18next account-ui English bundle
validated_findings.trigger: A user-profile multivalue size validation error is rendered in the account console (keycloak.v3), whose messages are consumed by i18next with '{{n}}' interpolation as used by every neighboring key in this file (e.g. "'{{0}}' contains invalid character.").
validated_findings.verifier_reason: The patch changes messages_en.properties to use {0} style placeholders, but the verifier code at line 124 explicitly handles 'error-invalid-multivalued-size' by replacing choice syntax with '...'. The server-side themes use MessageFormat, not i18next. Without evidence this file is consumed by i18next without transformation, the claim is ungrounded.

validated_findings.suggested_fix: Keep this admin-ui English value in i18next '{{n}}' syntax, or confirm and document the conversion layer that transforms MessageFormat syntax before it reaches i18next.
validated_findings.title: MessageFormat choice syntax placed in i18next admin-ui English bundle
validated_findings.trigger: A user-profile multivalue size validation error is displayed in the admin console (keycloak.v2), whose bundles use i18next '{{n}}' interpolation as shown by neighboring keys (e.g. 'userNotSaved=The user has not been saved\: {{error}}').
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Same reasoning as candidate 3. The admin-ui messages_en.properties change uses MessageFormat syntax, but the verifier explicitly handles this key. No concrete evidence that i18next directly consumes this without transformation layer.
